evidence: Clicked 'New Resume'; editor opened with blank 'Untitled Resume' and empty Contact/Summary/Experience/Education/Skills fields.
Template tab offers Modern/Classic/Minimal presets; selecting Classic instantly changed the Live Preview layout and was saved with the resume.
Entered Contact (name/email/phone/location/LinkedIn/website), Summary, Work Experience, Education, and Skills; all fields accepted input and appeared in preview.
Sections tab allows renaming (e.g. 'Work Experience' -> 'Career History') and reordering (moved Experience below Education) via up/down buttons; preview reflected both changes.
'Live Preview' panel present throughout editing, showing formatted resume matching entered data.
Card menu 'Duplicate' created 'QA Test Resume (Copy)'; 'Rename' dialog with Save button renamed it to 'QA Test Resume - Job B'.
Created and duplicated resumes resulting in 5 saved versions listed on dashboard simultaneously (QA Test Resume, QA Test Resume - Job B, plus 3 seed resumes).
Search box filtered list to 'Marketing Manager Resume' when typing 'Marketing'; sort combobox 'Oldest First' correctly reordered cards by date; Title A-Z/Z-A options also available.

issue: No validation for conflicting/invalid time ranges in experience entries
actual: Entered Start Date 2023-01 and End Date 2021-01 for a work experience entry (end before start). The app accepted it without any error/warning and displayed 'Jan 2023 - Jan 2021' in the live preview.

evidence: Date fields are native HTML input[type=month] controls; programmatically setting an invalid string ('invalid-text') resulted in the input value being rejected/cleared, confirming only valid YYYY-MM format is accepted.

issue: Saved resumes are lost after a full page reload
actual: Created 'QA Test Resume' and 'QA Test Resume - Job B' and confirmed they persisted while navigating within the SPA (back to dashboard and reopening). However, after navigating to http://localhost:7005/ (full page reload), both newly created resumes disappeared from the dashboard list; only the original 3 seed resumes remained.

evidence: Every edit (contact fields, summary, experience, education, skills, template switch) was immediately reflected in the Live Preview panel within the same snapshot with no stale or missing content observed.
Clicking the down-arrow to reorder 'Work Experience' below 'Education' and typing a new heading both applied instantly, visible in the very next snapshot without needing extra confirmation.

issue: No success feedback shown after saving
actual: Editing fields and navigating back (which auto-saves, confirmed by data persisting in the dashboard) triggered no visible toast/notification/confirmation message. The 'Notifications' region remained an empty list in snapshots taken immediately after edits and after leaving the editor.

evidence: Checked Minimal template on 'Product Designer Resume': all sections (header, summary, experience with 2 entries, skills, education) rendered fully with no missing or truncated content in the accessibility tree.

After leaving the editor and reopening 'QA Test Resume' via dashboard, all entered fields (name, email, phone, location, LinkedIn, website, summary, experience, education, skills, renamed/reordered sections, classic template) were fully retained with no missing fields.

Changed Location field to 'Berlin, Germany' in the duplicated 'QA Test Resume - Job B'; reopening the original 'QA Test Resume' still showed 'Paris, France', confirming independent storage between versions.
Title 'QA Test Resume' matched consistently between the dashboard card heading and the editor header/title button across multiple navigations.
